start.note: DosKit plays the first song in its menu, Shadowrun. Up, Down and Enter pick another, Escape switches between the menu and the playing screen, and F10 returns to DOS.

hint: Journey 2 waits at its menu: press Enter to play the highlighted song. Up, Down and Enter pick another, Escape switches screens, and F10 returns to DOS.
